judgments.why: B places the transaction icons in white circular containers, which echoes the quick-action circles and gives the list a clearer visual anchor. A's bare icons float loosely and feel less finished, even though the two screens are otherwise identical.

A's white circular icon containers give the transaction rows a consistent left anchor that echoes the quick-action circles, while B's bare small icons look sparse, less polished, and weaker as visual anchors.

B's circular containers for the transaction icons echo the quick-action buttons and give the list a stronger, more finished rhythm, while A's bare glyphs float and look unfinished; B's circles do sit a bit tightly stacked.
